A 63-year-old female presents to the emergency department following a fall, resulting in a right distal
radius fracture. Initial testing reveals a serum sodium of 128 mEq/liter. Her medical conditions include
hypertension, hypothyroidism, osteoporosis, and depression, managed with lisinopril 20 mg daily,
amlodipine 5 mg daily, levothyroxine 100 μg daily, sertraline 100 mg daily, and alendronate 70 mg
weekly. She is alert and oriented, with normal vital signs and physical examination findings except for
her casted right forearm. Laboratory results after 6 hours show: | | Patient value | Reference range | | ---
